verdictMeaning: Architecture is sufficiently defined and safe to implement as one vertical slice. Decisions below are recommended MVP defaults, not open blockers.
notImplementedConfirmation: NO CODE WAS IMPLEMENTED. No files modified except this audit artifact. No Flutter publisher, no RTDB client writes, no Maps/ETA/L3, no API/schema/rules changes.

currentArchitecture.summary: L1 acquires/classifies foreground GPS on the assigned-ride screen only. L2 backend already accepts trip locations via POST /v1/location/update, authorizes assigned driver + publishable states, durably accepts locationStreams, then projects RTDB latest. Flutter does NOT call the location API yet and does NOT write RTDB.
backendPipeline: if rideId: assignedDriverId==auth.uid && state in LOCATION_PUBLISH_RIDE_STATES
currentArchitecture.gap: No Flutter → HTTP location publisher. Accepted fixes stay inside DriverLocationLifecycleController (_lastAccepted) and are not exposed to a network layer.

proposedArchitecture.integrationPoint: Inside DriverLocationSession / LifecycleController after ACCEPTED classification — never raw geolocator stream
flow: map to POST body (rideId, locationSeq, locationStreamId, lat, lng, accuracy, heading, speed, timestamp, provider)
Backend auth → assignment/state → validate → locationStreams accept → RTDB latest
proposedArchitecture.rtdb: Flutter NEVER writes RTDB. Backend Admin projection only.
proposedArchitecture.idleMode: OUT OF SCOPE for Step 4. Trip-mode only (rideId required). Idle publishing remains future/N-series if needed.
proposedArchitecture.maps: OUT OF SCOPE. No Maps SDK/UI, no passenger listener, no ETA.

publishStop: screen dispose / sign-out / background / driver offline
notes: RIDE_COMPLETED is NOT isDriverJobTerminalState for polling UI, but GPS/publish MUST stop (not in shouldWatch / LOCATION_PUBLISH_RIDE_STATES).
Reassignment impossible server-side (ALREADY_ASSIGNED); publisher still binds hard to session rideId arg.

locationApiContract.auth: Bearer Firebase ID token; App Check header when enabled

requestBody.rideId: string required for trip mode (Step 4 always set)
requestBody.locationSeq: non-negative integer; must be > lastAcceptedSeq for active stream
requestBody.locationStreamId: non-empty string; new id replaces stream and resets seq carry-over
requestBody.heading: finite number REQUIRED (send 0 if unknown)
requestBody.timestamp: ISO string or epoch ms; must be within now-15s .. now+5s

locationApiContract.idempotency: NOT supported for location POST (docs/algorithms/idempotency.md). Transport retries must remain off.
locationApiContract.concurrency: Firestore transaction on locationStreams/{rideId}_{driverId}; closed stream rejects; late previousStreamIds rejected
locationApiContract.rtdbProjection: after durable accept only; failure does not fail HTTP

authentication.cache: Firebase SDK cached token; getAccessToken uses forceRefresh=false
authentication.recommendation: Reuse ApiClient only. Do not create a second auth stack. Location POST must use CancelToken and idempotent:false.

publishPolicy.philosophy: Conservative MVP — prefer freshness within server stale window without saturating 60/min rate limit
publishPolicy.heartbeatRule: If no movement publish for 10s and last accepted fix is still fresh (<12s old), republish latest accepted (not a stale queued history)
publishPolicy.duplicateSuppression: Classifier already drops exact duplicate timestamp+lat+lng; publisher also skips identical lastPublished payload

rationale.battery: L1 already stops GPS in background; throttle reduces radio wakeups
rationale.trackingSmoothness: 4s/15m + 10s heartbeat keeps RTDB latest useful without map work in this step

sequencePolicy.locationStreamId: UUID generated once per GPS watch start (controller generation). New watch after background/foreground or ride re-entry → new stream id.
sequencePolicy.locationSeq: Start at 1 for each new locationStreamId. Increment by 1 for each outbound publish attempt that is actually sent. Never reuse a seq for different coordinates.
sequencePolicy.onSequenceViolation422: If local seq is behind server, bump local seq to lastPublishedSeq+1 and wait for next fresh fix (do not invent coords). Prefer next accepted fix over aggressive burst.
sequencePolicy.onNewRide: Session family key is rideId; new ride ⇒ new session ⇒ new stream + seq=1

retryPolicy.offline: Drop; wait for next accepted fresh fix when online
retryPolicy.timeout: Drop in-flight; do not replay same body; next fresh fix may publish
retryPolicy.401: Rely on ApiClient single refresh+retry once; if still 401, stop publisher and surface session-level auth failure (existing patterns)
retryPolicy.403_RIDE_LOCATION_FORBIDDEN: Stop publisher for this ride immediately (terminal/unauthorized)
retryPolicy.403_offline_or_not_approved: Stop publisher; reconcile with driver availability UI
retryPolicy.422_STALE_INVALID: Drop; wait for next accepted fix
retryPolicy.422_SEQUENCE_VIOLATION: Adjust seq policy above; do not tight-loop
retryPolicy.429: Backoff (e.g. 2–5s) then resume with fresh fix only
retryPolicy.5xx: Drop; next fresh fix; optional light backoff 1–2s

failureBehaviorMatrix.noInternet: No queue; skip; continue GPS locally; publish when network returns with fresh fix
failureBehaviorMatrix.http403: Stop publish for ride / offline as above
failureBehaviorMatrix.http409: Not used by location API today; treat as stop+log if seen
failureBehaviorMatrix.appBackgrounding: Existing L1 stops GPS; publisher must cancel in-flight and pause
failureBehaviorMatrix.appForegrounding: Existing L1 may restart ONE watch; new stream id; no duplicate session if autoDispose family intact
failureBehaviorMatrix.cancelWhileInFlight: CancelToken cancel; ignore late response; stop
failureBehaviorMatrix.completeWhileInFlight: Same as cancel; ride state listener stops wantsWatch
failureBehaviorMatrix.permissionRevoked: Existing failure readings holdRestart; publisher idle

raceConditionProtections.A_fixThenCancel: Publisher checks rideState/wantsPublish immediately before send; CancelToken if state flips
raceConditionProtections.B_inFlightThenTerminal: CancelToken on stop; ignore response after generation mismatch
raceConditionProtections.C_assignmentFlicker: Hard-bind publisher to session rideId; server rejects wrong assignment; reassignment impossible (ALREADY_ASSIGNED)
raceConditionProtections.D_multipleGpsListeners: Single LifecycleController subscription per session; do not add second geolocator watch for publish
raceConditionProtections.E_foregroundBackgroundDuplicate: Keep autoDispose family; no keepAlive on session; generation++ on stop; one WidgetsBindingObserver path
raceConditionProtections.F_oldRideSurvivesIntoNew: Family arg=rideId; dispose stops old; new ride new streamId; never carry seq across rides

riskAudit.mitigation: Server Step 1 gate remains; client only sends rideId
Explicit ban; publish via backend only
Stay autoDispose; single controller; physical metric watch_starts
Force idempotent:false; no custom retry loop on same body
Always send finite heading (0 if unknown)

implementationOrder: 1. Add accepted-fix emission hook on DriverLocationLifecycleController (no network inside controller)
2. Add DriverLocationRemoteDataSource mapping DriverLocationFix → POST /v1/location/update via ApiClient (idempotent:false, CancelToken)
3. Add DriverTripLocationPublisher (seq/streamId, throttle, heartbeat, single-flight, stop/cancel)
4. Wire publisher into DriverLocationSession dispose/start; bind rideId from family arg; listen ride state
5. Wire driver offline → onDriverOffline(true) if availability signal already exists on assigned-ride screen
6. Unit tests for publisher policies + failure matrix
7. Widget/lifecycle tests ensuring no duplicate session publishers
8. Staging physical proof on SM-A325F: publish→RTDB + cancel stops + bg/fg single publisher
9. Regression: Flutter driver location tests + backend Step1/2/3 suites if any shared touch (expect none)
10. STOP — do not start passenger listeners / maps / L3

definitionOfDone.backendAcceptance: Authenticated trip publishes return 200 with accept snapshot for assigned publishable states
definitionOfDone.rtdbProjection: After accept, staging RTDB tripLocations/{rideId}/latest matches server-authorized payload (physical verify)
definitionOfDone.noDuplicatePublishers: One active publisher per ride session; bg→fg does not stack publishers
definitionOfDone.noStaleReplay: No offline queue; no republish of aged coordinates beyond classifier/server freshness
definitionOfDone.cancellationStop: Cancel/complete stops GPS watch and cancels in-flight HTTP; no further publishes
definitionOfDone.backgroundForeground: Background stops; foreground restarts at most one watch/publisher for same ride
definitionOfDone.physicalDeviceProof: SM-A325F evidence artifact with publish→RTDB and cancel-stop
definitionOfDone.regression: Existing L1 location unit tests green; backend location suites remain green without API changes
definitionOfDone.explicitNonGoalsMet: No Flutter RTDB writes, no maps, no passenger listeners, no ETA, no L3

UUID stream per watch generation; seq from 1 monotonic per stream
